section: Acquisition of possibility concept and language
text:
Acquisition of possibility concept and language
The majority of my PhD work (namely, my dissertation) focuses on the acquisition of possibility concept and the role of language in that process. I ask: are possibility concepts the sort of concepts that have to be constructed through language learning?



Yanwan Zhu & Roman Feiman.


Toddlers use “if”, rather than “when”, to talk about mere possibilities


Manuscript under review.

title: Research
text:
Language Acquisition in Understudied Populations
When I was an undergrad at Smith College, I worked with Jill de Villiers on a project focusing on Romani-speaking children in Europe. In our paper, in addition to presenting data on Roma children’s linguistic knowledge, we argued that studying language acquisition in understudied populations like Roma children is important, highlighting both the scientific merits and the societal implications.



Hristo Kyuchukov, Jill de Villiers, Yanwan Zhu, & Iris Zhong (2025).


Assessing the acquisition of Romani in Roma children


Language Acquisition.
